sources.use_review_basis: January 2026 PDF linked from owner Ecce Homo Bar Napoli menu at Largo Ecce Homo 3. Existing published static n8071588010 is the unique Ecce Homo pub on that Largo; its OSM/static row omits civic, website and phone, while owner contact states no. 3. Only explicit EUR drink and serving prices are included. Unpriced bottled beer, snacks and delivery-food-only cover are excluded; drink fee coverage unknown. Distilled spirits 2cl and 4cl are distinct from Gin & Tonic cocktails.
